annotations.title: Validate a store's UCP discovery file

description: Free validator for a store's Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) discovery file at /.well-known/ucp. Pass url to fetch a public store's file, or document to check pasted JSON. Returns a verdict, every rule result, and a fix list: each failed rule with the change that fixes it. Reads one public file, stores nothing, calls no checkout endpoint. No API key required.

inputSchema.description: Send exactly one of url or document.

document.description: The discovery document's JSON text, checked without any fetch

url.description: Public store URL or domain, e.g. shop.example.com

name: ucp.validate

outputSchema.description: Either a validation (ok=true) or a business error (bad arguments, rate limit) — never a fabricated report.

fixes.description: Failed rules, errors first, each with the change that fixes it.

oneOf.description: Business error — e.g. missing or conflicting arguments, invalid url, rate limit.

title: Validate a store's UCP discovery file
